done.why: Wandered a few rooms with no goal and no feedback. The chest was locked with no key in sight, and nothing pulled me forward.

about: An underground cave world. A dream-mentor told me to seek him when I'm worthy. I found a stone with a sword in it, a cloaked figure, an underground sea, a sunlit cliff and a locked chest.

moments.note: Pitch dark with a grue warning right away; I had to guess to turn the lantern on.
The sword jumped into my hand when the hooded figure appeared, and it glowed. That was cool.
Locked chest and no key. I had no direction and nothing to do about it.

wished: A clearer goal or a nudge toward what to do next
A way to open the chest

lines.line: From nowhere, the sword from the junction appears in your hand, wildly glowing!
lines.why: The one moment that surprised me.

fun.why: Aimless wandering with one nice moment.

engagement.why: Nothing pulled me forward, so I quit.

difficulty.why: No guidance, but I did not get far enough to be stuck on a puzzle.

interestingness.why: The setting is atmospheric, with an underground sea and sunlit trees.
